These terms cover every booking made on this website. In short: you pay by card in Thai baht (THB); day tours are fully refundable when you cancel 48 hours or more before departure, 50% refundable at 24–48 hours and not refundable under 24 hours; Ang Thong tours are fully refundable 48 hours or more before departure and not refundable after that; and if we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. These terms apply from 1 November 2026.

Summary of the cancellation policy

Sections in this page: who we are, bookings, prices and payment, ages, pickup, cancellation by you, cancellation by us, date changes, refunds, health and safety, partner-operated trips, liability, reviews, images, complaints, governing law and changes.

1. Who we are

This website is run by an Australian-Thai tour team based on Koh Samui and Koh Phangan since 2006, licensed by the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT licence 43/01467). In these terms, "we", "us" and "our" mean the business that runs this website, and "you" means the person making the booking and every guest on it. You can reach us on WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 (daily 08:00–20:00 Thailand time) or at the email address on our Contact page. Our Koh Samui office is on Chaweng Beach Road, Bo Phut 84320.

By making a booking you accept these terms and our privacy policy. The person who books must be 18 or over and accepts these terms for everyone in the booking.

2. Bookings and confirmation

  • A booking is made when you pay in full through our checkout or a payment link we send. Your contract with us starts when we confirm the paid booking.
  • We confirm every booking by email or WhatsApp after payment. Your pickup time follows by email or WhatsApp the evening before the trip. Every booking is checked by a person before we confirm it.
  • Online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time (ICT, UTC+7). For example, to book a trip on Saturday you must pay before 00:00 on Friday night.
  • There is no same-day online booking. For a trip today, message us on WhatsApp and we'll tell you if a seat is available.
  • Groups of 10 or more, private charters and villas are booked by enquiry: we send a written quote and a payment link, and the booking is confirmed once paid.
  • Please check names, dates, guest numbers and your hotel on the confirmation and tell us at once if anything is wrong.
  • We may refuse or cancel a booking, with a full refund, if we suspect fraud, payment misuse or false details.

3. Prices and payment

  • All prices are charged in Thai baht (THB). THB is the currency of record. Prices shown in EUR or USD are for reference only and are converted from THB; the amount your bank charges depends on its own exchange rate and fees.
  • You pay by card (including Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them) through a secure checkout run by our payment processor, Stripe. We never see or store your full card number.
  • Prices are per person unless a trip is sold per boat or per jet ski. The price on your confirmation is final; later price changes don't affect a paid booking.
  • Each trip page lists what is included and what is not.
  • Park, island and entry fees are not included unless the trip page says so, and are paid in cash on the day. These include the Ang Thong National Park fee (300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child in 2026), the Koh Nang Yuan landing fee on the Koh Tao trip (250 THB per adult) and the Koh Madsum landing fee where it is not included (about 50 THB). The Full Moon Party entry fee (about 200 THB) is paid at the gate; we sell boat transfers, not party tickets.
  • Fees set by the national park, island owners or event organisers can change without notice. You pay the fee charged on the day.

4. Age bands and children

Adult12 years and overAdult price

  • Children must be booked in the correct band. The crew may ask for proof of age.
  • Children's life jackets are provided on every boat and must be worn by children on board.
  • Children must be supervised by an adult in the booking at all times, on the boat, in the water and on land.
  • Park fees use their own age bands, which can differ from ours.

5. Pickup and transfers

  • Hotel pickup is included from most areas of Koh Samui. Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut (and other remote areas) add 400 THB per person, return. The surcharge areas depend on the departure pier and are shown in the booking form for each trip.
  • Give us your exact hotel or villa name and area when you book. We can't pick up from places a vehicle can't reach safely; we'll agree the nearest meeting point with you.
  • Be ready in the lobby or at the agreed point 5 minutes before your pickup time. Drivers can't wait long, because other guests are on the same route.
  • If you are not at the pickup point at the confirmed time and we can't reach you on the number you gave, the booking counts as a no-show. If the driver doesn't arrive within 10 minutes of the pickup time, message us on WhatsApp at once.
  • If you choose to make your own way to the pier, there is no refund for an unused transfer.

6. Cancellation by you

This is the one cancellation policy for every trip on this site. Times are counted from the scheduled departure time in Thailand time, and from when we receive your cancellation message.

Day tours

Full refund if you cancel 48 hours or more before departure. 50% refund if you cancel 24–48 hours before departure. No refund if you cancel less than 24 hours before departure or do not show up.

Ang Thong tours (day and overnight)

Full refund if you cancel 48 hours or more before departure. No refund if you cancel less than 48 hours before departure or do not show up.

Other trips

Pig Island, Koh Tao, Full Moon Party and Half Moon Festival transfers, jet ski safaris and private boats follow the day-tour rule above.

  • To cancel, message us on WhatsApp or by email with your booking reference. The time we receive the message counts.
  • A no-show includes missing your pickup, arriving at the pier after the boat has left, or being refused boarding under section 10.
  • Bad weather forecasts, illness, flight changes or late transport are not cancellations by us. If you cancel for these reasons, the rules above apply. We recommend travel insurance that covers trip cancellation.

7. Cancellation or changes by us

If we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. The captain and the operator decide whether a boat can sail safely, using the morning sea state, wind and official marine warnings. Their decision is final, and safety comes before any schedule.

  • Ang Thong closure: Ang Thong National Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December. We don't sell Ang Thong trips for those dates. If the park authority closes the park on other dates, for storms or conservation, the trip is cancelled and you choose a full refund or a new date.
  • Itinerary changes: the crew may change the order of stops, shorten a stop or replace a stop with a safer one for weather, tides, sea state, park rules or crowding. This is part of running boat trips safely and is not a cancellation.
  • Events: party dates are set by the organisers. If an organiser moves or cancels a party, we offer a transfer on the new date or a full refund of the transfer price.
  • If we must cancel for any other reason within our control, you get a full refund.

8. Date changes

If you want to move your trip, message us as early as possible with your booking reference and the new date. Changes depend on space on the new date and are confirmed in writing. If we can't offer a date that suits you, the cancellation rules in section 6 apply.

9. Refund method and timing

  • Refunds go back to the card used for the booking, in THB. We don't refund in cash or to a different card.
  • We process refunds within 7–10 business days of the cancellation. Your bank may take a few more days to show the credit.
  • Because you pay in THB, the amount your bank credits in your home currency can differ from the amount it originally charged, due to exchange rates and card fees. We refund the full THB amount due.
  • Park, island and entry fees are paid in cash to the authority or island on the day, so we can't refund them. If you don't travel, you don't pay them.

10. Health, safety and conduct

Boat trips in the Gulf of Thailand mean sun, heat, waves, wet landings, swimming and sometimes steep climbs. By booking you confirm that every guest is fit to take part.

  • Fitness: some trips include steep steps or rough paths, for example the Ang Thong viewpoint climb of about 500 m that takes 25–45 minutes up, and the Koh Nang Yuan viewpoint. These stops are optional. Tell us before booking about any mobility needs; our accessibility page explains each trip.
  • Medical conditions: speedboats can bump hard in waves. We advise against speedboat trips for guests who are pregnant, have back, neck or heart conditions, or have had recent surgery. Ask your doctor before booking. If in doubt, ask us about calmer options such as the Ang Thong big boat.
  • Seasickness: take medication before departure if you are prone to it. Leaving a trip early because of seasickness is not a cancellation by us.
  • Swimming and snorkelling: you swim at your own risk and must follow the crew's instructions. Non-swimmers must wear a life jacket in the water. Children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on board.
  • Alcohol and drugs: the crew may refuse boarding, without refund, to anyone who is drunk, under the influence of drugs, or whose behaviour puts others at risk. Illegal drugs and vapes are banned in Thailand.
  • Crew instructions: the captain's instructions on safety, seating, swimming and landing are final.
  • Park rules: follow national park rules, including bans on taking coral or shells, feeding wildlife and swimming in the Ang Thong Emerald Lake. Fines are set by the park.
  • Your belongings: look after your phone, camera and valuables, and use a dry bag. We can't accept responsibility for items lost, damaged or wet on the trip.

11. Partner-operated trips

Some trips are delivered by licensed local boat operators and activity partners that we select. They are sold under these terms and this cancellation policy, and your booking, payment, pickup and support stay with us. We share only the details the partner needs to run your trip, as set out in our privacy policy.

12. Liability and insurance

  • We take care in choosing boats, crews and partners, and in planning safe trips. We are responsible for delivering the services you booked with reasonable care and skill.
  • As far as Thai law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as missed flights, hotel nights or other plans, or for delays and cancellations caused by weather, sea conditions, park or government decisions, strikes, illness or other events outside our control.
  • Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under Thai law.
  • We strongly recommend travel insurance that covers medical treatment, evacuation, boat trips, snorkelling and trip cancellation. If you ride a scooter on Samui, your licence and policy must cover it.

13. Reviews

Only guests who have booked and taken a trip can leave a review on a trip page. We don't edit reviews or pay for them. We remove reviews that are abusive, contain personal data or are clearly not about the trip, and we don't remove honest negative reviews.

14. Images and content

The text, photos and maps on this site belong to us or are used under licence or with the owner's permission. You may share links to our pages. You may not copy, republish or sell our text or photos without written permission. To ask about using a photo, or to report one you believe is yours, contact us through the Contact page.

15. Complaints

If something goes wrong on a trip, tell the crew or message us on WhatsApp at once, so we can try to fix it on the day. After the trip, send your booking reference and what happened by WhatsApp or email. We reply during our working hours (08:00–20:00 daily) and aim to resolve every complaint fairly.

If you are not satisfied, you can also contact the Tourist Police on 1155 or the Tourism Authority of Thailand call centre on 1672.

16. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand. Any dispute that we can't settle with you directly goes to the courts of Surat Thani province, Thailand, which covers Koh Samui. This doesn't remove any consumer rights you may have under the law of your home country.

17. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The version that applies to your booking is the one published on the day you paid. Each version is dated at the top of this page. Questions about these terms are welcome on WhatsApp or by email; see our Contact page and the Koh Samui FAQ.
